scope: Scientific-boundary decision audit. It records whether a candidate may enter a future named model case; it does not itself alter Base LP mathematics, data, or solver runtime.

findings.basis_rule: Historical pre-M1 results are not scientific comparators; the current M1 topology gate remains valid only for unchanged active LP structure.
findings.decision: Existing VRE now uses cohort_survival_v1 with fixed_floor_v1 control; site technical upper and connection proxy remain after generator retirement. Wind/PV trunk uses the CISPO potential-weighted equivalent peak without hourly LP expansion.
findings.next_gate: No further change unless an exact time-coincident shared-export formulation is separately scoped.

findings.basis_rule: A duplicate-COMID flow correction changes hydrology coefficients/RHS but not the named sparsity pattern; never use a warm result across it as scientific acceptance.
findings.decision: Candidate static_capacity_potential_share_v1 allocates each GRFR reach discharge once across co-mapped stations using exogenous technical-potential shares. It prevents duplicate water while retaining LP linearity. The current uncommitted worktree passed the dedicated hydro tests, full local regression, and isolated 1h/24h Base cold gates.
findings.next_gate: Commit after owner review; then treat it as a new scientific case and decide whether a fresh 168h gate is warranted.

findings.basis_rule: A replacement inflow/environmental-flow dataset changes the scientific case even if the LP topology remains unchanged.
findings.decision: The current monthly_environmental_flow_2019_p30 is an explicit single-year proxy; formal multi-year P30 and open-/closed-loop PHS water pairing are not yet supported.
findings.next_gate: Acquire and validate the required hydrology inputs before proposing a named sensitivity or Base replacement.

findings.basis_rule: Registry-only corrections do not invalidate a structurally compatible basis, but every result must carry the resolved scenario parameter snapshot.
findings.decision: The Base registry remains limited to inactive Base flexibility values. The active comfort_envelope_v3_v2g_5pct override is now enumerated in an additive scenario registry and checked against the resolved configuration.
findings.next_gate: Keep evidence status and low/base/high sensitivity requirements explicit; no LP solve is required for registry-only changes.

findings.basis_rule: Post-solve lifecycle accounting is not a re-optimized carbon-feasibility result. A sourced lifecycle factor entering the carbon constraint changes the scientific case.
findings.decision: The CISPO-equivalent zero-lifecycle baseline and 5/10/20% post-solve screens are correctly separated, but the nonzero values remain SCREENING_ASSUMPTION_REQUIRE_SOURCING.
findings.next_gate: Build an evidence table with China-relevant biomass supply, processing, transport, capture, storage and leakage bounds before any LP integration decision.

findings.basis_rule: Any endogenous duration/SOC/deliverability adequacy formulation changes LP topology and requires a fresh basis family.
findings.decision: The 5% provincial capacity margin, static capacity credits and deterministic reserve proxy remain explicit model assumptions. They are not multi-weather ELCC, EUE or LOLE evidence.
findings.next_gate: First design a fixed-capacity post-solve adequacy audit; only then decide whether a sparse planning LP formulation is justified.

findings.basis_rule: Base keeps flexible_load=false. A calibrated flexible-load scenario has a separate topology and must never reuse a Base scientific result.
findings.decision: The existing comfort-envelope V3 is a sensitivity with daily boundaries and province-generic thermal parameters, not a calibrated building-service model or endogenous flexibility purchase decision.
findings.next_gate: Obtain building thermal/participation/cost evidence, then evaluate a separately named low/base/high scenario; do not alter Base.

findings.basis_rule: Fleet-physical V1G/V2G changes the scenario topology and requires an isolated gate.
findings.decision: The current V1G backlog and daily-cyclic V2G are causally constrained sensitivities, but do not represent observed connection availability, driving withdrawal or departure SOC.
findings.next_gate: Create province-hour availability, charging-power, driving-energy and departure-SOC inputs before promoting any EV case.

findings.basis_rule: A city-hourly or route-resolved CO2 network is a new formulation family, not a basis optimization.
findings.decision: city_337 is an annual intra-provincial proxy and the CO2 system is province-to-sink accounting. Results must not be described as city-hourly congestion or route-topology planning.
findings.next_gate: Only implement if the research question requires those claims; otherwise preserve the stated interpretation boundary.

findings.basis_rule: Changing wave activation, potential or shared-export treatment changes the scientific case; do not call it a solver-only comparison.
findings.decision: The user-declared Base remains wave enabled and flexible load disabled. Wave potential/cost are explicit sensitivity risks; a CISPO-compatible reference, if needed for the paper, must be a separate named scenario rather than a silent Base change.
findings.next_gate: No Base change. Define a separately named reference only when the paper comparison question is fixed.

findings.basis_rule: MGA is prohibited until a closed accepted scientific full-year Base anchor with matching resolved configuration and inputs exists.
findings.decision: Persistent runner design and small-scale gates may continue, but no production MGA result is admissible from truncated roots.
findings.next_gate: Wait for an accepted full-year Base anchor; do not use the historical truncated 744h evidence as a substitute.
